abilities.name: Aspect of Death
abilities.description: Deathwing is fitted with 4 Armor Plates which grant 10 Armor each. Every 25% Health lost causes Deathwing to lose a plate. Plates are only restored when Dragonflight is used, based on the amount of Health Deathwing has when landing. Deathwing is also a mighty Dragon Aspect who is permanently Unstoppable and deals 100% additional Spell Damage to Heroes, but views his allies with contempt and ignores any of their friendly effects.; trait

fields.type: Defensive damage modifier, Offensive damage modifier, Status effect
fields.notes: Deathwing uses Energy instead of Mana as a resource. Deathwing has 100 max Energy, which regenerates at 5 Energy per second (even while channeling Molten Flame). Deathwing can still be affected by allied and enemy Time Stop and pathing blockers and by enemy non-crowd control debuffs, like Attack Slows, Damage over time, Damage modifier, Healing modifier, Revealed, Armor debuffs and hero specific debuffs that are not tied to applying a crowd control effect on the target. Deathwing cannot be eaten by Zagara's Devouring Maw (but its pathing blocking properties still work). Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Deathwing's damage. Armor bonus stacks additively with itself, but not with other Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack. Deathwing does not heal while in the Hall of Storms or after casting Hearthstone. Deathwing can heal himself by using Dragonflight, benefiting from Regeneration Globes, using Healing Fountains, and by selecting certain talents.

abilities.description: When D.Va's Mech dies, she is ejected out after 0.75 seconds and can continue to fight. D.Va's Mech only awards 50% of a normal Hero's XP upon dying. Fusion Cannons D.Va's Mech Basic Attacks deal 22 damage in a large area every 0.25 seconds. Deals 40% bonus damage against enemies very close to the Mech.; Trait

fields.notes: 1) Primary target must be within 3.75 range while secondary targets can be hit up to 5.0 range. Upon issuing an attack command on an enemy unit, D.Va attempts to move to a range where the target enemy can be hit by bonus damage. Damage dealt to the Mech from enemies within Defense Matrix still grants the same amount of Self-Destruct Charge.; 10 / 0.5

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Mobile channel
fields.notes: 1) Offset to the start of the area. Defense Matrix can be canceled using the trait button to end its effect early. Damage reduction from Defense Matrix stacks multiplicatively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting the target Heroes' damage output.

abilities.name: Self-Destruct
abilities.description: Requires Mech Mode. Eject from the Mech, setting it to self-destruct after 4 seconds. Deals 400 to 1100 damage in a large area, depending on distance from center. Deals 50% damage against Structures. Gain 1% Charge for every 2 seconds spent Basic Attacking, and 25% Charge per 100% of Mech Health lost.

fields.notes: Each Basic Attack grants 0.125% Self-Destruct Charge (even if the attack misses due to being Blinded or the target Evading). Hitting multiple enemies does not increase the Charge gained. Charge gained from damage taken is calculated after all damage modifications, excluding Defense Matrix. Self-Destruct can be activated while Boosters can be deactivated after leaving the Mech to stop it in its place. If Mech has taken fatal damage Self-Destruct cannot be used. Upon cast D.Va is ejected from the back of the Mech and the Mech itself becomes Unkillable and turns into a Heroic Pet, allowing it to be hit by Abilities that can target Heroes. Exploding Mech can be afflicted and moved with crowd control and Stasis effects, like Stitches's Gorge, but these effects cannot suppress the Mech's explosion. Explosion can only be delayed by placing the Mech in Time Stop. Using Self-Destruct to eject from the Mech awards no experience or Takedown credit to enemies. If the Mech is Rooted prior to D.Va ejecting and the root expires before it explodes, it will move toward the location of the last move order issued while D.Va was in the Mech. At certain Hero levels, explodes immediately when hit by Malthael's Throwing Shade.

abilities.name: Loot Hoard
abilities.description: Throw a pile of junk onto the battlefield, dealing 102 damage in a small area, knocking enemies away and acting as terrain for up to 5 seconds. When the Loot Hoard expires or is destroyed, a chunk of Meat falls out that can be picked up to restore 3% of maximum Health every second for 4 seconds. Reactivate to destroy Loot Hoard.

fields.type: Terrain / Spell Damage, Crowd control / Healing
fields.props: Area of Effect, Heal over Time, Knockback, Self-castable
fields.notes: Loot Hoard can be reactivated 0.5 seconds after it has spawned to end its effect early. This still spawns Meat. Loot Hoard is aligned with the map grid and must be placed on a location, where it does not collide with Hogger's unit radius and its center does not collide with existing terrain. Picking up Meat while under its effects adds to its total duration. Meat stays on the ground for up to 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.description: Rage is gained by taking damage or dealing Basic Attack damage. Hogger’s Basic Ability cooldowns refresh 1% faster for every 2 points of Rage. After 3 seconds of not gaining Rage, it begins to quickly decay.

fields.notes: Hogger gains 5 Rage when landing a Basic Attack and 1 Rage each time he takes damage. Decays by 0.8125 per 0.0625s (13 per second) after not gaining any Rage for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Staggering Blow
abilities.description: Swing your chain in a wide arc, dealing 140 damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. If an enemy collides with terrain, deal an additional 150 damage, Stun for 0.75 seconds, and gain 15 Rage.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Knockback, Stationary channel (1 , Stun
fields.notes: 1) The swing is channeled and the search is split in three 40 degree sections, rotating counter-clockwise over 0.1875 seconds. Enemies are knocked away radially from Hogger. Damage from terrain hit is dealt in a separate instance. Hogger's Basic Attack is placed on a 0.375 second cooldown when Staggering Blow finishes casting.

abilities.name: Ez-Thro Dynamite
abilities.description: Toss a bundle of Dynamite with a 1.5 second fuse. Upon detonation, enemies take 180 damage and are Slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. The Dynamite instantly detonates when landing directly on an enemy Hero and grants Hogger 10 Rage.

fields.notes: Dynamite bundle takes 0.5 seconds to reach its end location regardless of distance. Instant detonation only triggers on the enemy Hero closest to the dynamite's center, causing the Rage gain and talent bonuses only to be applied once per dynamite regardless of how many Heroes were hit. Dynamite bundle grants vision over its area before detonating.

abilities.name: Hogg Wild
abilities.description: After 0.25 seconds, become Unstoppable and uncontrollably spin towards the target direction, ricocheting off terrain. Ricocheting off terrain refreshes the duration. Every 0.125 seconds, deal 44 damage to nearby non-Structure enemies. Damage against Heroes is increased by 0.5% for each point of Rage.

fields.type: Spell Damage / Movement: Dash, Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Self-castable, Unstoppable
fields.notes: Hogg Wild can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to end its effect early. Bouncing off terrain instantly sets the speed to 14.5. During Hogg Wild Hogger also bounces off of Structure units and his Loot Hoard, but ignores collision with any other units, including pathing blockers like Tassadar's Force Wall. Contact with terrain is checked from the centerpoint of Hogger's hitbox. Cooldown starts when the Ability ends. Rage damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Hogg Wild 's damage.

abilities.name: Hoardapult
abilities.description: Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds. Hoardapult’s Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Self-castable, Slow, Unstoppable
fields.notes: Hoardapult can be canceled after 0.75 seconds to end its effect early. The initial point of vector targeting determines the location of the Loot Hoard unit and the second which direction Hogger will be positioned next to it. Hoardapult can exceptionally be cast while Rooted. Hogger is Unstoppable while in the air. In addition to Hoardapult 's damage, enemies also take damage from Loot Hoard 's impact. Loot Hoards created by Hoardapult and Meat dropped by them have the same properties as their base version and interact with Talents affecting them, except that the initial Meat drop from Bones to Gnaw does not happen. Hogger automatically consumes Meat if he is within the pickup radius and not at maximum Health. The first Meat can be collected instantly. If Hogger is not within the decay radius, Hoardapult's duration is reduced by 0.5 seconds every 0.0625 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Hogger's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow or Ez-Thro Dynamite increases the damage of the next Basic Attack within 8 seconds by 50%, stacking up to 2 times. When Hogg Wild ends, gain 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

talents.name: Secret Stash
talents.description: Every 2 seconds, Hoardapult’s Loot Hoard randomly launches Ez-Thro Dynamite, prioritizing nearby enemy Heroes. Every 5 seconds, it also launches a chunk of Meat toward Hogger.

fields.notes: Dynamite bundles launch at a set 4.5 distance towards a random enemy Hero, if there are any within 7 radius. If no enemy Heroes are within the radius at the time, dynamite bundles are launched to one of 8 predetermined locations chosen randomly. Dynamite bundles launched by Secret Stash have the same properties as the base version and interact with all talents affecting Ez-Thro Dynamite, except Dense Blasting Powder. Meat is launched at a set 4.0 distance in Hogger's direction. Secret Stash 's Meat launch cooldown is independent from Hoardapult's Meat pickup and does not require Hogger to be full Health. The first Meat is launched after 5 seconds. Meat launched by Secret Stash interacts with all talents affecting Meat.

_raw_fields: Every 2 seconds, Hoardapult’s Loot Hoard randomly launches Ez-Thro Dynamite, prioritizing nearby enemy Heroes. Every 5 seconds, it also launches a chunk of Meat toward Hogger.

talents.name: Power Spike
talents.description: Hitting Heroes with Shockwave reduces their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds and grants 20 Rage. Passive Rage's cooldown reduction affects Shockwave's cooldown.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Hitting Heroes with Shockwave reduces their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds and grants 20 Rage. Passive Rage's cooldown reduction affects Shockwave's cooldown.

talents.name: No Control
talents.description: Cooldown 60 ActiveActivate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby. Cannot be canceled.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Mobile channel, Movement speed, Unstoppable
fields.notes: No Control increases Hogger's Movement Speed by 10% every 0.0625 seconds, stacking up to 24 times (~16.5 max speed). Hogger loses 2 stacks every 0.0625 seconds if the current target is within 1.75 range. Bounces choose the farthest targetable Hero in the range that has not been targeted within the last 2 seconds. The current target is revealed for 0.125 seconds every 0.0625 seconds while Hogger is traveling to them. If Hogger has no viable bounce targets, the duration of No Control begins to decay by 0.1875 seconds every 0.0625 seconds.

_raw_fields: Cooldown 60 ActiveActivate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby. Cannot be canceled.

talents.name: Anger Management
talents.description: Increase maximum Rage by 50, raising the maximum bonuses for its cooldown refresh rate to 75% and Hogg Wild's Hero damage to 75%. Passive Basic Attacks grant 5 additional Rage.
_raw_fields: Increase maximum Rage by 50, raising the maximum bonuses for its cooldown refresh rate to 75% and Hogg Wild's Hero damage to 75%. Passive Basic Attacks grant 5 additional Rage.

abilities.name: Valorous Brand
abilities.description: Each Basic Ability marks enemy Heroes hit for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks consume the target's marks, dealing 20% bonus damage per mark and healing for 75 per mark.; trait

fields.notes: Marks are consumed even if Imperius is Blinded or if the target is Evading. The healing still occurs, though all of the damage misses except from specific Talents. A Hero can not be marked by the same Basic Ability more than once at a time. Further applications refresh the duration. Stacks additively with itself and other Physical Damage modifiers.

abilities.name: Celestial Charge
abilities.description: Lunge toward a targeted direction and stab, dealing 35 damage. If an enemy Hero is hit, Channel to Stun for 1 second and deal 80 additional damage when it finishes.

fields.type: Spell Damage / Crowd control / Movement: Launch
fields.props: Area of Effect, Stationary channel, Stun
fields.notes: Imperius moves with a speed of 14 and is able to pass through terrain. Enemy Heroes hit are snapped toward the center line of the area within 1.5 - 4.5 units in front of Imperius. If the Channel lasts for its full duration, the targets are Stunned for an additional 0.25 seconds while the bonus damage is being dealt.

abilities.name: Solarion's Fire
abilities.description: Release a fiery wave that deals 110 damage. Enemies hit by the center take 50% bonus damage and are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: The wave has a sight range of 2. Center damage bonus stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Solarion's Fire 's damage.

abilities.name: Molten Armor
abilities.description: Shroud Imperius in flames for 3 seconds, striking a nearby enemy for 19 damage every 0.25 seconds. Imperius heals for 50% of the damage dealt, increased to 100% against Heroes. Strikes 2 additional targets if no Heroes are in range, and restores 1 Mana for each strike on expiration.

fields.notes: 1) Targets one enemy per tick prioritizing enemies currently Stunned by Celestial Charge, then the closest enemies, prioritizing Heroes only if equidistant from Imperius. If there are multiple targets within the search area, the same target can not be hit again until all or up to 4 different targets in the area have been hit. Can be activated while leaping or channeling Celestial Charge. Molten Armor will only hit revealed/visible targets.

abilities.name: Angelic Armaments
abilities.description: Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 Shield for 3 seconds. If the Shield lasts the full duration, this Ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 damage to the first enemy hit.; 70; 70; heroic

abilities.name: Wrath of the Angiris
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving. After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 250 damage to them, increased by 20% for each Valorous Brand mark on them when landing, and Stunning them for 1 second.; 80; 80; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.affects: Enemy Heroes (damage, cc) / Enemy Heroes & Self (status effect)
fields.props: Channeled cast (stationary), Skillshot, Stasis (in air), Stun, Unstoppable (dash)
fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its cast puts it on a 10-second cooldown. Doesn't affect Vehicles. While in air both Heroes are put in Stasis. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, Imperius and the target are removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), have no collision, cannot regenerate Health, Mana, Energy or Shields and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed. The target is affected by a hostile Stasis, causing some delayed healing Abilities to be prevented. Landing location can't be steered over unpathable terrain. Upon landing, the target enemy Hero is placed at the center of the indicator, facing Imperius. Imperius will be positioned 2 units in front of the target, so that the target is positioned in the direction he was moving toward before landing. Valorous Brand marks placed by Imperius will not be removed when launching the target into the air. Marks can still expire while in the air

talents.name: Impaling Light
talents.description: Celestial Charge deals 150% more damage to Heroes, reduced by 25% for each additional Hero hit. For each Valorous Brand on the target when Celestial Charge's Stun completes, reduce its cooldown by 1 second. passive Reduce Celestial Charge's cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and its Mana cost from 40 to 30.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Celestial Charge 's damage.

abilities.description: Leoric becomes a ghost when he dies, and resurrects upon reaching full Health. Leoric deals no damage while dead. Wrath Of The Bone King Leoric's first two Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage, and his third Basic Attack deals 225% damage to a single target.; trait

abilities.name: Wraith Walk
abilities.description: Leoric separates from his body, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed accelerating up to 50% over 2.5 seconds. When Wraith Walk ends or is canceled, his body jumps to his wraith.; 14 / 0.25

fields.notes: Can be cast while Rooted. Wraith Walk can be reactivated after 0.25 seconds to apply its end effect early. Leoric's Wraith is an Invulnerable Summon that has regular base Movement Speed. Wraith's Movement Speed can be affected by conveyor belts in Volskaya Foundry. Leoric can pass through pathing blockers and enemy Gates while Wraith Walking, but not through real terrain. Unstoppable is removed before teleporting to Wraith. abilities.name: Molten Core
abilities.description: Channel on an allied or destroyed Fort or Keep to replace it with Ragnaros's ultimate form, temporarily gaining new Abilities, having 3996 Health that burns away over 18 seconds. Ragnaros returns to his normal form upon losing all Health in Molten Core.

fields.notes: Interrupting Molten Core during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Ragnaros can exit Molten Core after a 1 second channel by reactivating the Trait. Exiting can be canceled by pressing the Trait button again before the channel is complete. Successfully casting Molten Core puts real Ragnaros and the target Structure in Stasis for its duration and replaces them with different Molten Core Ragnaros unit. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, real Ragnaros is removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), has no collision, cannot regenerate Health, Mana, Energy or Shields and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed. Molten Core Ragnaros cannot be targeted by friendly Abilities during Molten Core. Buffs, like Heal over time effects, applied to real Ragnaros beforehand persist for their duration, but cannot affect Molten Core Ragnaros. Molten Core Ragnaros cannot be targeted or affected by Abathur's Ultimate Evolution, Sylvanas's Black Arrow disable or Zagara's Devouring Maw.

abilities.description: Passive Misha gains 15% Movement Speed. Command Misha to attack a specific enemy or move to a point and wait. Targeting Rexxar commands Misha to retreat to his position, gaining 30% move speed until she reaches Rexxar. Targeting Misha commands her to hold her current position. Misha

fields.notes: Killing Misha rewards a Takedown credit and 0.25 Hero kills/XP. When Misha is dead, killing Rexxar rewards a Takedown credit and 0.75 Hero kills/XP. If Misha is alive while Rexxar is killed, she dies as well, totaling a full Hero kill/XP and two Takedown credits. Misha's death timer is 14s+.5s/level. Rexxar becomes unable to control Misha while he is unable to act (Stunned, Dazed or put in Time Stop or Stasis, other than Feign Death) or Silenced. If Rexxar enters a Vehicle or is some other way removed from the battleground, Misha will be removed from the Battleground as well. Issuing Move and Attack commands to Misha doesn't dismount or break objective channels, hearthstone or dismount, but using Abilities will. Rexxar and Misha share the effects of Healing Fountains. Both Rexxar and Misha can pick up Regeneration Globes, but their effect is not shared. Misha's passive Movement Speed bonus does not stack with other Movement Speed bonuses, including the bonus from the 'return' command. When Rexxar is Mounted, Misha's Movement Speed bonus is increased to 30% while she is within 6 radius.

abilities.name: Life-Binder
abilities.description: Bind Alexstrasa's life force with an allied Hero. Both she and her target are healed for 480 over 2 seconds. Afterward, the Hero with a lower percentage of health is set to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.

fields.notes: Life-Binder immediately ends, going on full cooldown, if either of the two linked Heroes dies, becomes Time Stopped, enters a Vehicle or hostile Stasis or otherwise becomes untargetable by friendly Abilities. The heal resolves normally if the target ally enters a friendly Stasis effect, like Ice-Block or Bunker. However, the Ability still ends if Alexstrasza herself enters Stasis through means other than her Dragonqueen transformation.

abilities.name: Cleansing Flame
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop fireballs at the position of your mouse cursor every 1.2 seconds for 6 seconds. Each fireball restores 300 Health to nearby allied Heroes, and deals 135 damage to nearby enemies. 2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of your mouse cursor.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Stasis
fields.notes: Interrupting Cleansing Flame during its cast period puts it on a 10-second cooldown. Cleansing Flame 's cooldown starts when the Ability is successfully cast. For the duration of the Ability, Alexstrasza is put in Stasis. In addition to the usual effects of Stasis, Alexstrasza is removed from the ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), has no collision, cannot regenerate Health, Mana, Energy or Shields and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed. Dragonqueen 's duration is paused during Cleansing Flame but its cooldowns are not.

abilities.name: Eye of Horus
abilities.description: Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

fields.notes: Eye of Horus can be canceled after 0.5 seconds through the 'W' or 'E' key. If Eye of Horus is canceled or interrupted before any shots are fired, it will not be put on cooldown. Channel can last indefinitely and will only end if interrupted, manually canceled or once all shots have been fired.

abilities.name: Blood Rage
abilities.description: Passive Basic Attack and Ability damage cause enemies to bleed for 44 damage over 4 seconds. Stacks 5 times. Active Qhira deals 32 damage and heals for 90 Health per enemy Hero affected. Damage and healing are increased by 50% per each additional stack on that Hero.

fields.notes: Active component is disabled if no enemies are affected by the passive. Subsequent applications of the DoT add to its damage and refresh its duration. Damage from either Blood Rage 's active or passive do not add or refresh any stacks. Damage from both bleed and activation can affect non-Heroes, but do not trigger healing. Damage and healing bonuses from the active component stack additively with itself and multiplicatively with other modifiers. If multiple Qhiras are on a team, each of them can apply their own Bleed damage over time to the target. However, only the unit who placed the first Bleed stack on the unit may activate and benefit from Blood Rage on it. Additionally, the stack count and duration are shared among all Bleed effects applied on the target, meaning that any Qhira (re)applying Bleed instantly inherits the current stack count, increments it and refreshes the duration of all active Bleeds on the target.

abilities.name: Revolving Sweep
abilities.description: Attach your sword to the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 96 damage and Stunning them for 0.25 seconds. Once attached, Qhira becomes Immune to all effects, rotating around the target for 2.75 seconds, and dealing 105 damage to any enemies between you and the target. Reactivate to send you to the target's location, knocking them away, dealing 108 damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.; 16 / 0.25

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.props: Clamping, Evasion, Knockback, Skillshot, Stun, Untargetable
fields.notes: Rotation is always clockwise and at set distance from the target. While Qhira is swinging, she is Unstoppable and untargetable, nullifies all incoming damage, Evades Basic Attacks and has no collision. Qhira is unable to attack, move or use her abilities other than Grappling Hook and Revolving Sweep's reactivation. Swing behaviour is instantly removed, dropping Qhira at her current location (as long as it's on pathable surface), if: - the target becomes Unstoppable or Invulnerable - the target or Qhira is put in Stasis or Time Stop - the target instantly moves farther than 10 units from Qhira's current location - the target is Falstad during Flight or Ragnaros during Molten Core - Qhira latches on to a Hero or terrain with Grappling Hook. If the ability has not been reactivated or interrupted, swinging stops after completing one full circle and Qhira is placed at range distance from the target.

abilities.name: Mirror Image
abilities.description: Teleport a short distance in the direction of the mouse cursor, creating 2 images for 8 seconds with 100% of Samuro's current Health that Basic Attack enemies for 11 damage. Images have their duration increased by 1 second each time they or Samuro use a Basic Attack against an enemy Hero. Whenever an Image takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes. Maximum 2 Mirror images can be active at a time. Using Mirror Image removes most negative effects from Samuro. Mirror Image

fields.notes: Samuro appears in the direction of the player's mouse cursor when Mirror Image is cast. Samuro and his Mirror Images spawn in an equilateral triangle around the point where the ability was cast from. Using Mirror Image puts Samuro in Stasis for 0.125 seconds, removing most debuffs from Samuro and making him briefly untargetable and immune to damage. Usable while Rooted as it is cleansed by the Stasis. Samuro and the Images retain the last attack command given to Samuro before casting the Ability and attempt to complete it when the cast ends, unless they are spawned within Basic Attack range of another target, in which case they will focus that target instead. Mirror Images deal the same type of damage that Samuro does. Mirror Images gain all benefits from Samuro's Trait and Talents affecting it. Mirror Images can be affected by Regeneration Globes' healing, but cannot pick them up themselves. The effect is not shared between Samuro and his Images. Killing Mirror Images rewards no XP or Takedown credit.

Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible. Samuro is Unrevealable for the first 1 second of Wind Walk.

fields.notes: Using Mirror Image and Mounting during the Unrevealable period will break Stealth once the Unreveable ends.

abilities.name: Weapon Mode: Repeater Cannon
abilities.description: Basic Attack speed increased by 150%. Activate to change to Weapon Mode Phase Bomb, increasing Basic Attack range and damage and causing Basic Attacks to splash.

fields.notes: Repeater Cannon's single-target DPS is twice that of Phase Bomb. Switching weapon modes does not dismount nor does it interrupt mounting, hearthing or channeling objectives. Attack Speed stacks additively with other effects that can affect Fenix's Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Weapon Mode: Phase Bomb
abilities.description: Basic Attacks have 1.25 increased range, deal 25% more damage, and splash to nearby enemies. Activate to change to Weapon Mode Repeater Cannon, increasing Basic Attack Speed.

fields.notes: Damage bonus is implemented as a direct base damage increase, causing it to stack multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers. Switching weapon modes does not reset Fenix's auto-attack timer. The auto-attack timer ticks from its current completion percentage according to the weapon mode currently selected. Therefore, by attacking exclusively with Phase Bomb and quickly switching to Repeater Cannon and back just between auto-attacks (ideally staying in Repeater Cannon mode for all of the auto-attack downtime), Fenix can benefit from the bonus range, damage, and splash damage of Phase Bomb as well as the bonus attack speed of Repeater Cannon.

abilities.name: Purification Salvo

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Mobile channel
fields.notes: 1) Scan is performed in twenty-four 7.5 degree sections rotating counter-clockwise over 1.5 seconds and only detects visible enemy Heroes. Fenix cannot attack or use his Abilities while channeling. Interrupting the Ability during the channeled targeting period puts it on a 10-second cooldown. Purification Salvo missiles can only be disjointed if the target dies, is removed from the plane (certain Stasis effects) or instantly teleports farther than 60 units from its previous location. When disjointed, the missile expires upon reaching the target's location before the event. Otherwise, the missiles will keep redirecting to the target unit. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Purification Salvo 's damage.

fields.type: Spell Damage / Movement: Teleport, Status effect
fields.notes: 1) Slash AoEs consist of a 1.0 x 6.0 rectangle in the middle and 1.0 x 5.0 triangles on both ends. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, Genji is removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles) and has no collision, but does not receive the initial expanded debuff removal. Distance and duration of the displacement depend on how far the target is hit from the center of the Mine, with the longest being the farthest.

abilities.description: Create a Decoy for 5 seconds with 100% of Nova's current Health that attacks enemies, dealing 10% of Nova's base damage. fields.notes: Decoy can use Snipe and Pinning Shot with reduced damage and Slow values. Decoys only use their Abilities against Heroes. If Nova is Stealthed while casting Holo Decoy, the decoy will also be Stealthed and vice versa. Stealthed Decoys only attack Heroes. Unstealthed decoys also attack Structures, Summons and aggroed Mercenaries, but not Minions, unless the Lethal Decoy Talent has been picked. Decoys will immediately attack the closest visible enemy Hero when one comes in its range and mimics Nova's Basic Abilities in the following order: Pinning Shot > Snipe > Basic Attack. Killing a Decoy grants no XP or Takedown credit. Decoy benefits from all of Nova's non-active Talents, unless otherwise noted. Decoy has its own base damage values, causing the damage reduction percentage to stack multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers, but displays the floating damage text as if it were from the real Nova (full damage value).

_raw_fields: Cooldown 70 Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

abilities.name: Resonance Beam
abilities.description: Tassadar's Basic Attack is a Channeled beam that Slows by 15%. While Channeling, your Basic Attack damage and Mana Regeneration increase by 25% a second, to a maximum of 100%. While at full charge, gain an additional 3 Mana per second. This bonus is lost after 6 seconds of not Channeling.; trait

fields.notes: Each tick grants 6.25% Resonance Beam charge. Gaining charge in any way resets the duration. Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Tassadar's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Shock Ray
abilities.description: Channel a beam of Psionic energy, dealing 280 damage and Slowing enemies in a line by 30% for 2 seconds.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Slow, Stationary channel
fields.notes: Tassadar can start moving after the channel although there is an additional 0.0625s delay (noted above) before the beam appears from its cast location. Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 0.5 second cooldown. Cooldown does not start until the channel completely finishes. It is possible to reduce the cast time to 0.1 seconds through an input buffer: W > Basic Attack > Q (buffer is easier to execute while Archon is active).

abilities.name: Psionic Storm
abilities.description: Create a Psionic Storm at the targeted location for 3 seconds. While in a storm, enemies take 38 damage every 0.5 seconds, increasing by 20% for each consecutive instance of damage, up to 100%.

fields.tickrate: - Damage: 2.0 per second (x6) - Target search: 4.0 per second (x11)
fields.notes: Enemies can only be affected by one Psionic Storm at a time. This also applies in the event there are multiple Tassadars in a team. Damage bonus tracks each target separately and can carry over to another cast of Psionic Storm, if it damages the target within 0.4 seconds of the last damage instance. This also applies to Psionic Storms cast by different Tassadars. A target with no existing stacks that is hit by a full-duration Storm will take 342 damage (excluding scaling and other damage modifiers). Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and offensive damage modifiers.

abilities.name: Force Wall
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second delay, create a wall that blocks all units from moving through it for 2 seconds.; 18 / 0.5

fields.notes: 1) Area consists of four overlapping circular blocking units with 1.0625 radius. Force Wall can be reactivated 0.5 seconds after it has spawned to end its effect early. Force Wall grants vision in 6 radius.

abilities.name: Archon
abilities.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds. Resonance Beam Deals 140 damage to the target and splashes 70 damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.; 90; 100; heroic

fields.type: Physical Damage, Defensive damage modifier / Shield
fields.props: Attack Modifier, Spell Armor reduction, Splash
fields.notes: Tassadar cannot Mount while in this form. Cooldown starts when the transformation ends. Archon benefits from Resonance Beam 's Slow and Mana regeneration bonuses, but not from the damage bonus. Archon attacks benefit from all talents enhancing Resonance Beam, except Khaydarin Amulet. Does not stack with itself or other negative Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second cast, launch a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled toward its center. Touching the center deals 310 damage and Stuns for 1.25 seconds.; 60; 60; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Displacement, Stun
fields.notes: Interrupting the cast during its windup puts the Ability on a 10 second cooldown. Pull from Black Hole does not apply Daze, allowing the target to control their Hero's movement and actions as normal and causing it to be unable to interrupt channels (without getting hit by its center). Heroes hit by the center continue to be pulled until they leave Black Hole's area, but cannot be hit by the center again.

talents.name: Static Charge
talents.description: Questonly Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increase its damage by 5 and grant 33% Resonance Beam charge. Maximum of 200 additional damage.
_raw_fields: Questonly Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increase its damage by 5 and grant 33% Resonance Beam charge. Maximum of 200 additional damage.

talents.name: Psi-Infusion
talents.description: Increases the range of Psionic Storm by 33%. Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.

fields.notes: Mana refund can trigger multiple times on the same target.

_raw_fields: Increases the range of Psionic Storm by 33%. Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.

talents.name: Khaydarin Amulet
talents.description: Quest Resonance Beam charges 50% faster. After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 80 seconds, it bounces to hit 1 additional target for 75% damage. Reward After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 160 seconds, it bounces to hit 2 additional targets for 75% damage.

fields.notes: Bounce radius is extended by the target's unit radius. Bounces chain from the secondary target. Secondary attacks Slow. Secondary targets do not grant additional charge. Archon Basic Attacks do not bounce. Damage reduction to both bounces is relative to damage dealt to primary target. Damage reduction to secondary targets stacks multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Tassadar's Basic Attack damage. Target must be visible to initially bounce to them, and then is revealed while linked.

fields.notes: Secondary targets from Khaydarin Amulet and Archon do not generate a Psionic Storm. A Psionic Storm created by Arc Discharge interacts with all Talents affecting Psionic Storm. Does not benefit from cooldown reduction granted by Executor's Will.

fields.notes: Can also be cast while channeling Black Hole. Shadow Walk can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to end its effect early. talents.description: Cooldown 45 Passive While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 Health per second. Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

fields.type: Status effect / Defensive damage modifier, Healing
fields.props: Area of Effect, Stationary channel, Revealed, Spell Armor
fields.notes: 1) Reveal area radius grows in 0.5 increments every 0.125 seconds. Vision and Revealed status persists for 2 seconds after Tassadar stops channeling. Does not stack with itself or other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Cooldown starts when the Ability is cast. Spell Power from Executor's Will does not stack with itself, but stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting Tassadar's Spell Damage or healing output.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Searches for allies in range every 0.25 seconds. Lingers for 0.3125 seconds after going out of range. Spell Power from Khala's Gift stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting the target Hero's Spell Damage or healing output.

abilities.name: Reload
abilities.description: Tracer can Basic Attack while moving, and after attacking 10 times she needs to reload over 0.8125 seconds. Tracer can manually reload early by activating Reload. Basic Attacks heal Tracer for 10% of the damage dealt.; 1; Trait

fields.notes: Reload cannot be interrupted. Tracer's effective Attack Speed with Reload is 5.16 per second (Tracer's Basic Attack is available immediately when Reload finishes). Reload activates automatically when Tracer successfully Mounts or Hearths at a partially loaded clip.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Charge CooldownW 9 / 0.125 Dash toward an area. Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Melee
abilities.description: Deal 220 damage to a nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes. Gain 5% Pulse Bomb charge when using Melee against an enemy, and 10% against Heroes.

fields.notes: Cannot be activated if there is no targetable enemy within the cast range. Cannot target enemies that are not visible. Stops Tracer from Basic Attacking for 0.375 seconds upon activation.

abilities.name: Recall
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, Tracer returns to the position she was at 2 seconds prior to casting, refilling her ammo and removing all negative status effects from herself.

fields.notes: Can be cast while Rooted. Tracer is put in Stasis for 1.25 seconds before reappearing, removing most debuffs and making her untargetable and immune to damage. Teleport to end location takes place 0.1875 seconds after the Ability is cast. The destination of Recall is visible to enemy Heroes.

abilities.name: Pulse Bomb
abilities.description: Fire a short range bomb that can attach to an enemy if it hits them. The bomb explodes after 2 seconds, dealing 298 damage to them and 149 damage to other nearby enemies. This Ability is slowly charged over time by dealing damage to enemies with Basic Attacks and Melee.; Heroic

fields.notes: The Ability is available from the start of the game with 0% charge. Basic Attacks grant 0.75% charge each. This amount is unaffected by any damage modifiers on Tracer or her target. Enemies that walk over the center of the bomb while it's on the ground are considered primary targets and take the same damage as if the bomb were attached to them. Pulse Bomb will not attach to Structures, and will instead go through or land under them.

talents.name: One-Two Punch
talents.description: Reduce the cooldown of Melee by 1 second and it gains an additional charge.
_raw_fields: Reduce the cooldown of Melee by 1 second and it gains an additional charge.

talents.name: Parting Gift
talents.description: Recall leaves behind 6 bombs that deal 240 damage each to different targets. Heroes hit with these bombs are Slowed by 50% for 0.75 seconds and grant 7% Pulse Bomb charge.

fields.notes: The bombs are spread evenly in 60 degree intervals, one of them launched toward the direction Tracer was facing when casting Recall. Enemies cannot get hit by any of the bombs more than once. Bombs expire after 1 second.

_raw_fields: Recall leaves behind 6 bombs that deal 240 damage each to different targets. Heroes hit with these bombs are Slowed by 50% for 0.75 seconds and grant 7% Pulse Bomb charge.

fields.notes: Reveal is not applied in an area. Only the Heroes directly afflicted by Tracer Rounds receive the Revealed debuff.

talents.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe instantly heals Tracer for 15% of her maximum Health and reduces the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 15 seconds. Drinking from a Healing Fountain instantly heals for 20% of Tracer's maximum Health.

fields.notes: These effects are granted in addition to the basic benefits of Regeneration Globes and Healing Fountains.

talents.name: Sleight of Hand
talents.description: Reduces Reload time by 50%. This equals 20% more damage per second.

fields.notes: Reload time is actually reduced by only 46%, or if accounting for Tracer's Basic Attack being available immediately after reloading with or without this Talent, effectively a 55% reduction. talents.name: Focus Fire
talents.description: If an entire ammo magazine is unloaded on an enemy, the last bullet will deal 80 bonus damage. This is equal to 35% of the total magazine.

fields.notes: Focus Fire doesn't activate if Tracer hasn't attacked the target for 2 seconds, even if the clip is the same. Bonus damage can be affected by attack and damage modifiers, like Untouchable and lifesteal. Bonus damage from Focus Fire is dealt in a separate instance from the final Basic Attack, meaning that it cannot benefit from Ricochet. Bonus damage activates if the target was hit 10 times in a row instead of firing the last bullet, meaning Chrono Trigger won't trigger Focus Fire on the last bullet continuously.

_raw_fields: If an entire ammo magazine is unloaded on an enemy, the last bullet will deal 80 bonus damage. This is equal to 35% of the total magazine.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Tracer's Basic Attack damage. Can be activated while mounted without dismounting Tracer.

fields.notes: Tracer is healed after the Stasis from Recall ends for the difference between the Health she had 3.25 seconds earlier (i.e. at the time being "rewound to") and the Health she currently has.

abilities.description: Charge Cooldown 120 Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second. Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time. passive Creep spreads 15% farther. passive While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds. Nydus Worm ; 50; 120 / 2; heroic

fields.notes: Zagara can cast Nydus Network while inside a Nydus Worm. Other Abilities are disabled. Nydus Worms cannot be placed such that they overlap Structures or unpathable terrain or within 6 radius of an existing Nydus Worm. Placing a fifth Nydus Worm causes the oldest one to be destroyed. After being placed, Nydus Worm spreads Creep around it. This does not expire until the Nydus Worm is destroyed. Nydus worm has collision, is Unstoppable and immune to friendly Abilities and does not draw Minion aggro. Entering the Nydus Worm requires a 1.5 second channel that is interrupted upon taking damage. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara is put in Stasis. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, Zagara is removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), has no collision and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed. If all Nydus Worms are destroyed while Zagara is inside, she is ejected at the location of the last one.

abilities.name: Ultimate Evolution
abilities.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability. Ultimate Evolution Clone ; 70; heroic

fields.notes: Ultimate Evolution Clone is untalented and does not inherit any progress on baseline quests. It is possible to complete baseline quests on the Clone, but any progress and rewards are reset for the next cast. Clone does not gain Ability effects that are unlocked by reaching a certain level, such as Muradin's Storm Bolt pierce. Clone can Mount, use the Healing Fountain and can benefit from, but not directly collect, Regeneration Globes. The Clone can fake channeling Objectives, but it cannot complete the channel to capture the Objective. Some of the Clone's Summons, including Lunara's Wisps, and Nova's Holo Decoys do not expire when the Clone expires or is destroyed. However, Misha and Samuro's Images, Probius Pylons, and Junkrat Mines and Traps exceptionally do expire. There are some limitations and exceptions to cloning certain Heroes: - Deathwing cannot be cloned due to his Trait. - Cloning Cho'gall only grants access to Cho's Abilities. - Cloning a Viking only clones the specific Viking targeted. - D.Va's clone can only use the form she was cloned from. Pilot D.Va's Call Mech is disabled, and activating Self-Destruct in Mech mode immediately returns control to Abathur, leaving the exploding Mech on the Battleground. Additionally, if Ultimate Evolution expires during this time, the Mech will instantly explode as it does. - Kharazim's level 1 Talent is inherited, as it is his Trait, with Insight completed if that Talent was selected. - Murky's Trait, Spawn Egg, is disabled. - Alexstrasza's and Ragnaros's Traits start on full cooldown every time they are copied, making it impossible to use Molten Core and Dragonqueen during the clone's lifetime. - The effects of Jaina's Frostbite, Malthael's Reaper's Mark, Murky's Slime, Sylvanas's Banshee's Curse, Tassadar's Psionic Storm, and Zagara's Creep Tumor do not stack and are instead shared, benefiting both the clone and the cloned Hero regardless of who applied the effect. - Qhira and her Clone can both apply their own instance of Bleed from Blood Rage. However, only the unit who placed the first Bleed stack on the unit may activate Blood Rage on it. Additionally, the stack count and duration are shared among all Bleeds on the target, allowing both Qhira and Abathur to instantly gain the current stack count on the target and increment and extend each other's Bleed stacks on the target. Bleeds placed by the Clone also remain even after when the Clone has expired. - Both Probius and his Ultimate Evolution Clone can fully interact with each other's Pylons and Warp Rifts. - On death effects that change a Heroes state, such as the traits of Uther, Tyrael, and Leoric, are not inherited by the Clone. Other post-death events, such as Junkrat's Total Mayhem, are inherited. The Clone grants no XP or Takedown credit on death. The Clone's Summons do not benefit from this Ability's Spell Power bonus. Attack Damage and Spell Power bonuses stack additively with offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers.

abilities.name: Raven Form
abilities.description: Instead of mounting, Medivh can transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over all terrain and is immune to all effects.

fields.props: Immune to damage, Movement Speed, Untargetable
fields.notes: Medivh has reduced sight radius during Raven Form . Medivh cannot be targeted by allied or enemy effects while Mounted, but any effects applied beforehand persist for their duration. Using Abilities causes Medivh to leave Raven Form. Medivh cannot leave Raven Form, and thus also cannot use Abilities, while above unpathable terrain. Medivh can pick up and receive Regeneration Globes and use Healing Fountain in Raven Form . Medivh can collect Experience Globes while in Raven Form . Raven Form removes Medivh from the ground plane, disjointing certain projectiles.

Active Portals grant vision in 3.0 radius. If a Hero dies from Area of Effect damage during the Waygate Channel, but it is not otherwise interrupted, the Channel will still complete, which is relevant for Heroes with Special Death States (e.g. Leoric, Uther, Tyrael, Gall if taking Psychotic Break).

talents.name: Burn Notice
talents.description: Basic Attacks Slow enemies by 5% and deal an additional 18 damage over 2.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

fields.props: Attack Modifier, Damage over Time, Slow
fields.notes: Damage stacks up to 6 times, not 5, though the Slow stacks up to 5 times. Basic Attacks deal a tick of damage per new stack and refresh the duration of all stacks. They also restart the DoT tick timer for each stack, synchronizing them (so the next damage tick for all stacks will be 0.5s after the most recent Basic Attack). This also means DoT ticks that happen on the same server tick (1/16 s) as a Basic Attack generally happen twice (the DoT takes place and then the on-hit DoT tick from the Basic Attack resolves) There is observed to be about a 75% chance of this happening when a Basic Attack resolves, and a 25% chance of only 1 tick per stack, for reasons not fully understood. This is hypothesized to be because the Basic Attack, which applies and refreshes DoT durations, and the pre-scheduled DoT ticks happen on the same server tick, so which resolves first is seemingly random.

abilities.description: After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 damage per second to enemies. Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.; 100; 70; heroic

fields.notes: 1) Carrion Swarm's damage area consists of three cones in "opposite" directions that rotate every 0.0625s between three possible orientations. Regardless, enemies can only be damaged by the Ability once every 0.5 seconds. Interrupting the ability during its cast puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Mal'Ganis can move, but cannot use Abilities both while channeling and during Carrion Swarm. Carrion Swarm removes most negative effects from Mal'Ganis once the channel finishes and Mal'Ganis enters Stasis. Carrion Swarm sets the base lifesteal bonus to 75% against all enemies, which is against non-Heroic enemies reduced multiplicatively by 87.1%, resulting in 9.675% lifesteal when no other lifesteal effects are in place. abilities.description: Shields Tyrael for 350 damage and nearby allies for 40% as much for 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage dealt to allies shielded by Righteousness is shown in small pop-up numbers. Regardless of the real damage type of the attack, these numbers appear in orange, normally reserved for Physical Damage.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.description: Rake target area for 150 damage. For the next 3 seconds, allies moving through the targeted area gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: 1) Area consists of 5 overlapping circles with 1.5 radius in a wide V-shape. The ground effect lingers for 3 seconds, applying the buff to allies in the area every 0.25 seconds. Multiple instances of the buff only refresh the duration.

abilities.name: Judgment
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 damage.; 70; 80; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Knockback, Splash, Stun, Unstoppable
fields.notes: Interrupting Tyrael during the cast puts the Ability on a 10-second cooldown. Upon activation Tyrael gains vision of the target for the duration of the Ability. The cast is also interrupted if the target becomes untargetable, gains Stealth or moves farther than 5 units past its maximum cast range during the windup. Charging Tyrael can only be disjointed if the target dies, is removed from the plane (certain Stasis effects) or instantly teleports farther than 20 units from its previous location. When disjointed, the charge expires upon reaching the target's location before the event. Otherwise, the charge will keep redirecting to the target unit. Judgment always applies its area effects upon reaching the end location, regardless of being able to hit its original target. Tyrael is Unstoppable while charging.
